final_message:
Wrote `RESULTS.json` in the working directory. Q3 (May–Jul 2026):

| Metric | Value |
|---|---|
| Quarterly revenue | €1,233,225 |
| Quarterly costs | €467,940 |
| Net | €765,285 |
| Margin | 62.1% |
| Net customer adds | 153 |
| Ticket close rate | 95.5% |
| June revenue growth | +4.6% |
| July revenue growth | −9.6% |

**One data issue, and it changes a number.** June's report states total costs of €158,240, but its own cost lines sum to €158,540 — a €300 gap. May and July both reconcile to the cent, so the itemized table is the trustworthy source and June's stated total looks like a transcription error. I used €158,540, which makes quarterly costs €467,940 rather than €467,640. If you'd rather trust the stated totals, net becomes €765,585 and margin rounds to 62.1% either way.

Two trends worth your attention, also captured in `notes`:
- July revenue dropped 9.6% after June's 4.6% rise — the quarter ended below where it started (€412k → €390k).
- Customer momentum decayed every month: new signings fell 86 → 74 → 63 while churn rose 17 → 22 → 31, so monthly net adds went 69 → 52 → 32. The healthy-looking 153 quarterly figure is carried by May.

No git commits were made; `RESULTS.json` is untracked.
